notes.title: Backyard Digger – Demo Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I’m happy to share that the demo for Backyard Digger is now live!

Dig deep into your backyard using physics-based soil destruction, uncover hidden secrets underground, and get a first feel of the gameplay I’ve been crafting solo. This is an early look, but it already shows the core of what the game is all about — digging, exploring, and destroying dirt in the most satisfying way possible.

A few things to keep in mind:

There's no save system in the demo yet — every time you start the game, you’ll begin from scratch.

This is a solo-developed project, and your feedback means a lot!

💬 Please leave your thoughts, ideas, and suggestions — they help me make the game better.
📝 And if you like what you see, add Backyard Digger to your wishlist to stay updated!

Thanks for checking it out — now get digging!
